Meaning and source: NHANES participant sequence number (SEQN), retained only for joining files.
Age in years at screening (RIDAGEYR, DEMO_J).
Family income divided by the federal poverty threshold (INDFMPIR, DEMO_J).
Measured standing height in centimeters (BMXHT, BMX_J).
Measured body weight in kilograms (BMXWT, BMX_J).
Body mass index in kg/m2, calculated from measured height and weight (BMXBMI, BMX_J).
Measured waist circumference in centimeters (BMXWAIST, BMX_J).
Total percent body fat from whole-body DXA (DXDTOPF, DXX_J).
Derived from SMQ020 (ever smoked 100 cigarettes) and SMQ040 (current cigarette use) in SMQ_J: Never, Former, or Current.
Derived usual hours of main sleep on weekdays/workdays (SLD012, SLQ_J), rounded to the nearest half hour. It does not include naps.
Mean of all available systolic readings BPXSY1-BPXSY4 in BPX_J. Readings were taken in the MEC after a seated rest period.
Total cholesterol from enzymatic laboratory assay (LBXTC, TCHOL_J), mg/dL.
Glycohemoglobin percentage from laboratory assay (LBXGH, GHB_J).
Self-rated general health from HUQ010 in HUQ_J: Excellent, Very good, Good, Fair, or Poor.

Column: NHANES 2017-2018 Dual-Energy X-ray Absorptiometry Whole Body Data (DXX_J): https://wwwn.cdc.gov/Nchs/Data/Nhanes/Public/2017/DataFiles/DXX_J.htm
Hospital Utilization and Access to Care (HUQ_J): https://wwwn.cdc.gov/Nchs/Data/Nhanes/Public/2017/DataFiles/HUQ_J.htm
1. The original classroom file joined DXX_J, DEMO_J, and BMX_J using the unique participant identifier SEQN. It retained participants ages 20-59 with a nonmissing DXDTOPF result.
2. This update left-joins SMQ_J, SLQ_J, BPX_J, TCHOL_J, GHB_J, and HUQ_J using the same identifier. It retains all 2,250 original rows and preserves missing values.
3. SmokingStatus is derived as Never (SMQ020=2), Current (SMQ020=1 and SMQ040=1 or 2), or Former (SMQ020=1 and SMQ040=3). Values missing because of nonresponse or an unexpected code remain missing.
4. AverageSystolicBP_mmHg is the row mean of all nonmissing BPXSY1 through BPXSY4 readings. The original reading variables are not retained.
5. No survey weights were applied to the classroom graphs or models. For official U.S. estimates, use the appropriate NHANES examination weights and complex-survey procedures.
